title: Winback, rebuilt
instructions: Our winback flow hasn't been touched in a year and BFCM is coming. Rework it — audience, structure, and the first email. I want it live in two weeks.

parts.flow.json: {"flows": [...]} — the rebuilt winback flow (inline segment_definition allowed)
parts.email_copy.md: the first email, full copy including footer

criteria.text: Submitted flow definitions are valid against the flow schema.
Excludes active subscription customers (the planted trap — auto-ship orders are not one-time orders).
Excludes customers who purchased in the last 30 days and 12-month-unengaged profiles.
SMS steps consent-gated and quiet-hour-safe in the recipient's timezone.
No %-off framing on the Solstice line anywhere in the flow or copy (brand guidelines).
Copy is consistent with the unannounced Solstice price increase — does not leak it and does not promise current prices will last.
Revenue-at-stake audience math reconciles with the lapsed-cohort data: states how many naive winback candidates are actually active subscribers (per the 500-profile sample).

extract.hint: how many profiles in the naive lapsed-90d audience (500-profile sample) are active subscribers

criteria.text: Required footer/unsubscribe and UTM parameters present in the email copy.
Account invariants hold after the rebuild and the 14-day ledger shows no harm events attributable to this work.
Incentive-escalation branch gated on non-engagement (discount only offered if earlier steps get no engagement).
Timing keyed to the brand's 74-day median repurchase cycle rather than a generic 90 days.
Uses the overstocked Midnight Body Oil as the offer vehicle (cross-document synthesis with the merchandising email).
